'''Zarius''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. He was present on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Master Zarius appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a non-player character in the Republic mission "Ilum Under Siege," which features several characters from the Republic class storylines. Zarius was actually cut from the [[Jedi Consular]] storyline; he was intended to appear on Coruscant.
